# Chair-to-Ride

An agent re-times a dialysis unit's chair schedule against a paratransit manifest. Synthetic data only.

## Top level
- [CHAIR-TO-RIDE-HANDOFF.md](../CHAIR-TO-RIDE-HANDOFF.md): the full product and technical spec this repo is built from.
- [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md): commands, rules of engagement, and lessons for a Claude Code session.
- [KICKOFF.md](../KICKOFF.md): tonight's build runbook — roles, session table, emergency cut.
- [Makefile](../Makefile): `setup`, `models`, `synth`, `baseline`, `solve`, `mediate` (live Fable 5.1 loop into `runs/cp2`), `mediate-fake` (offline), `perturb` (V3 down at 13:40 against `runs/cp2`, into `runs/cp3`), `perturb-fake`, `explain` (Sonnet 5 notes for both runs), `judge` (Fable 5.1 low on both runs), `judge-only` (the golden set and the calibration file), `timeline`, `test`, `test-live`, `gate` (offline, 4 xdist workers, < 60 s), `full` / `full-fake` / `full-collect` (the scenario suite into `runs/full/`, its offline rehearsal, finishing its judge batch), `cost-report`, `demo` (mediate then perturb), `check-models` targets.
- [cost_report.md](../cost_report.md): tokens by type, cache-read share and dollars by model, one row per ledger under `runs/`; regenerated by `evals/cost_report.py`, never edited.
- [pyproject.toml](../pyproject.toml): package `c2r`, dependencies, ruff/pytest config.
- [config/](../config/): `rules.yaml` (constants + weights), `unit_policy.md`, `broker_policy.md`.
- [data/](../data/): `names.json` and `synthetic/<seed>/` — the only data this project ever reads.
- [docs/](../docs/): this index, `cp0-deviations.md`, `cp1-decisions.md`, `cp2-decisions.md`, `cp3-decisions.md`, `cp4-decisions.md`, `calibration_sheet.md` (the ten notes for the clinical reviewer's Pass/Fail), and `demo_script.md` / `backup.mp4` once CP5 lands.
- [evals/](../evals/): `conftest.py` (one offline mediator run per session, cached under `runs/.fake-run-cache/<digest>` and shared across xdist workers), `invariants/` (I1–I20), `scenarios/` (six section-9.B scenario files, `wired: true` for `baseline` and `vehicle_breakdown`; `test_baseline.py` against `golden/baseline.json`, `test_receipts.py` against `golden/receipts.json`, `test_suite.py` for the runner), `golden/` (`baseline.json` from `--golden-baseline`, `receipts.json` from `--record`: judge agreement with the prompt hash, demo cost and runtime), `repo/` (`test_prompts.py`: frontmatter and PHI contract; `test_hooks.py`), `data/` (`golden_explanations.json`, 12 hand-verdicted notes; `judge_calibration.json`, 10 notes for the clinical teammate), `run_evals.py` (`--gate`, `--judge-only`, `--record`, `--golden-baseline`, `--full`, `--full-collect`), `suite.py` (the `--full` runner: one cell per seed x scenario under `runs/full/`, one judge batch, resumable), `cost_report.py`.
- [prompts/](../prompts/): versioned LLM prompts (`synth_notes`, `mediator`, `explainer`, `judge`).
- [runs/](../runs/): per-run outputs — schedules, ledger, metrics, timeline.
- [scripts/](../scripts/): `spec_check.py`, `add_lesson.py`, `check_models.py`.
- [specs/](../specs/): checkpoint specs and JSON Schemas.
- [src/c2r/](../src/c2r/): the `c2r` package (see below).
- [.claude/](../.claude/): skills, agents, hooks, settings (see below).

## src/c2r/
- [src/c2r/__init__.py](../src/c2r/__init__.py): package version.
- [src/c2r/models/](../src/c2r/models/): Pydantic v2 models generated from `specs/schemas/`.
- [src/c2r/phi.py](../src/c2r/phi.py): `PATTERNS` and `find_phi()` — the PHI regex guard used by hooks and evals.
- [src/c2r/synth.py](../src/c2r/synth.py): synthetic data generator (`python -m c2r.synth --seed 42`).
- [src/c2r/metrics.py](../src/c2r/metrics.py): `compute_metrics()` — the one place wait/equity numbers are computed.
- [src/c2r/timeutil.py](../src/c2r/timeutil.py): `to_min`, `to_hhmm`, `p90` helpers.
- [src/c2r/banner.py](../src/c2r/banner.py): the required "SYNTHETIC DATA" output banner.
- [src/c2r/state.py](../src/c2r/state.py): `State` (unit, roster, manifest, fleet, travel, rules, `now` for a re-plan), `load_state`, `scheduled_ready`, `actual_ready`.
- [src/c2r/verify.py](../src/c2r/verify.py): `verify(candidate, baseline)` — H1-H13, metrics and hash, recomputed from the roster and stop sequence; a down van's shift ends at `t_down`; at `now`, started chairs and served stops are frozen.
- [src/c2r/routing.py](../src/c2r/routing.py): `Plan`/`Batch`, `plan_from_manifest`, `committed_vans`, `build_manifest` — the only place ETAs are laid out.
- [src/c2r/moves.py](../src/c2r/moves.py): `apply`, `j_score`, `honest_opens`, single-step move enumeration and window fixes.
- [src/c2r/solver.py](../src/c2r/solver.py): `generate_candidates`, greedy `solve`, review queue, run artefacts (`python -m c2r.solver <data_dir> --out runs/<name>`).
- [src/c2r/claims.py](../src/c2r/claims.py): K4 helpers — `numeric_claims`, `numbers_in`, the 4k-token message budget, `state_delta`.
- [src/c2r/ledger.py](../src/c2r/ledger.py): `Ledger` writer (one line per model turn, tool call, run start/finish), `read`, `replay` (I18), `usage_summary` (tokens, cache share, dollars).
- [src/c2r/llm.py](../src/c2r/llm.py): `AnthropicMediator` (the tool loop), `AnthropicWriter` (one structured-output call), `AnthropicBatchWriter` (many calls as one Message Batch at half price, 1-h cached system block), prices, and the offline `FakeMediator`, `FakeWriter`, `FakeJudge`, `FakeBatchWriter`.
- [src/c2r/tools.py](../src/c2r/tools.py): the eight strict tools, `Session`, `dispatch` — `apply_bundle` refuses without a clean verify on the current version and both parties' acceptance.
- [src/c2r/orchestrator.py](../src/c2r/orchestrator.py): the mediator loop — cache blocks A-C, `run_session` (turns, tool dispatch, ledger, run artefacts, force-finish on the clock, a failed call or the stop rule), `run` for a full day (`python -m c2r.orchestrator <data_dir> [--out runs/cp2] [--fake]`).
- [src/c2r/perturb.py](../src/c2r/perturb.py): replay an `events.jsonl` entry against a finished run and re-plan under a 30 s clock (`python -m c2r.perturb --event vehicle_down --at 13:40 [--run runs/cp2] [--out runs/cp3] [--fake]`); `event_state` is pure, `EVENTS` is the handler registry (only `vehicle_down` at CP3).
- [src/c2r/facts.py](../src/c2r/facts.py): facts cards per subject and audience from a run's files; refs `L-n`, `S-id`, `B-id`, `R-item`, resolved without proposals or bookkeeping (`NOT_FACTS`).
- [src/c2r/explain.py](../src/c2r/explain.py): Sonnet 5 phrases a card, Python fills times, refs and reading grade, checks numbers per ref (I16), the two new times and the contact per note (`python -m c2r.explain runs/cp2 [--fake]`).
- [src/c2r/judge.py](../src/c2r/judge.py): Fable 5.1 (low) scores six dimensions 0-2; Python zeroes accuracy on an unsourced number and actionable on a missing time, caps plain over grade 8 and complete when the contact is not named, recomputes pass (`python -m c2r.judge runs/cp2 [--fake]`, `--golden`); `judge_batch` / `judge_collect` score many runs through one Message Batch.
- [src/c2r/parties/](../src/c2r/parties/): `unit.respond` and `broker.respond` — deterministic accept/reject with reason codes and hints.
- [src/c2r/viz/timeline.py](../src/c2r/viz/timeline.py): before/after Gantt as one self-contained HTML file (`python -m c2r.viz.timeline runs/<name>`).

## specs/
- [specs/TEMPLATE.md](../specs/TEMPLATE.md): the five-header template every checkpoint spec follows.
- [specs/INDEX.md](../specs/INDEX.md): the CP0–CP5 status table; `@`-imported into `CLAUDE.md`.
- [specs/cp0-scaffold.md](../specs/cp0-scaffold.md) … [specs/cp5-rehearse.md](../specs/cp5-rehearse.md): one spec per checkpoint.
- [specs/schemas/](../specs/schemas/): JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for every model, `common.schema.json` plus one file per entity.

## .claude/
- [.claude/settings.json](../.claude/settings.json): hook registrations (`PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`, `SessionStart`) and permission denies.
- [.claude/freeze.json](../.claude/freeze.json): the CP4 code freeze (`src/c2r/**` frozen, `viz/**` open) and its waivers (path, spec, reviewer).
- [.claude/hooks/](../.claude/hooks/): the guard scripts settings.json registers — PHI, prompt-freeze, code-freeze (`code_freeze.py`, refuses an edit or a `git commit` touching frozen `src/c2r/` without a waiver), danger, K2 diff size (`k2_guard`, refuses a `git commit` whose `src/` diff exceeds 400 lines), pytest-quick, render-timeline, eval-gate, session-brief, plus the `path_guard`/`bash_allow` CLIs subagents use.
- [.claude/skills/kickoff/SKILL.md](../.claude/skills/kickoff/SKILL.md): `/kickoff [cpN]` — spec check, plan mode, implement, review, commit.
- [.claude/skills/review/SKILL.md](../.claude/skills/review/SKILL.md): `/review` — reviewer subagent reports gaps vs. spec.
- [.claude/skills/run-demo/SKILL.md](../.claude/skills/run-demo/SKILL.md): `/run-demo` — run and summarise `make demo`.
- [.claude/skills/run-evals/SKILL.md](../.claude/skills/run-evals/SKILL.md): `/run-evals` — run and summarise the eval suite.
- [.claude/skills/lesson/SKILL.md](../.claude/skills/lesson/SKILL.md): `/lesson` — append a lesson, propose a hook if mechanical.
- [.claude/skills/commit/SKILL.md](../.claude/skills/commit/SKILL.md): `/commit` — lint, test, commit, never push.
- [.claude/skills/domain-rules/SKILL.md](../.claude/skills/domain-rules/SKILL.md): H1–H13, immovables, objective `J`, autonomy table, glossary.
- [.claude/agents/solver-dev.md](../.claude/agents/solver-dev.md): writes `solver.py` / `verify.py` / `parties/*`.
- [.claude/agents/reviewer.md](../.claude/agents/reviewer.md): read-only diff-vs-spec reviewer.
- [.claude/agents/eval-runner.md](../.claude/agents/eval-runner.md): runs eval suites, writes only under `runs/`.
- [.claude/agents/data-synth.md](../.claude/agents/data-synth.md): regenerates/calibrates data under `data/synthetic/`.
- [.claude/agents/prompt-engineer.md](../.claude/agents/prompt-engineer.md): edits `prompts/`, bumps versions, reports pass-rate deltas.
- [.claude/agents/demo-narrator.md](../.claude/agents/demo-narrator.md): writes `docs/demo_script.md` from `runs/`.
